title: Charge Profusion Support Guide — Tiers, Extra Charges and Valid Generators
summary: Charge Profusion is a support gem family (Tier I and Tier II) that grants extra charges to skills that generate charges. It only works on charge-generating skills, and Tier II can also roll random extra charges. This guide covers what each tier does, why it is limited to charge generators, the probability math, valid generator matrix, and how it interacts with meta-skill support cost.
description: Charge Profusion support guide: Tier I vs Tier II, what each does, why only charge-generating skills, same-type vs random extra charges, valid generator matrix (Combat Frenzy, Profane Ritual, Sniper's Mark, Siphoning Strike), 30% and 15% probability, UI absence of random charges, old name Profusion, comparison with Overabundance / Boundless Energy / Perpetual Charge, charge cap handling, troubleshooting and community questions.
author: Exile2 Guides Editorial

sections.title: Quick Answer
paragraphs: Charge Profusion I grants an extra charge of the same type whenever the supported skill generates a charge; Charge Profusion II does the same plus a chance to roll a random extra charge.
It only works on skills that actually generate charges — a normal attack that creates no charge gets nothing.
The extra charge is the same type as the original; Tier II's random charge can be any charge type your character can use, and if you cannot use a rolled charge type, it is wasted.

supports.label: Charge Profusion I
notes: Grants an additional charge of the same type on generation.

supports.label: Charge Profusion II
notes: Same extra same-type charge as I.
Adds a chance to generate a random extra charge.

sections.title: Requirements
paragraphs: Charge Profusion must be socketed into a charge-generating skill. A skill that only deals damage with no charge generation cannot use it.

sections.title: Charge Profusion Family
paragraphs: When the supported skill generates a charge, Charge Profusion I adds one more of that same charge type. This stacks with the skill's own generation, so one trigger can yield two of the same charge.
Charge Profusion II adds the same, plus a percentage chance to also create a random charge. The random roll is independent and can produce a charge type your build uses or one it cannot.
If your character cannot use a randomly rolled charge type, that charge is effectively wasted — build around charges you actually consume.
bullets: II: +1 same-type plus chance of random charge.

sections.title: Support Interactions
paragraphs: Charge Profusion can be socketed into Combat Frenzy, Profane Ritual and similar generators. It is a meta-skill support, so the support cost multiplier of the meta skill applies on top of the gem cost.
When multiple charges generate at once, each generation event is evaluated separately for the extra and the random roll.
It does not replace the generator's own charge; it adds to it.

sections.title: Mapping Usage
paragraphs: In maps, Charge Profusion keeps your charge uptime high while clearing, which sustains auras and buffs that consume charges.
Use Tier I early; switch to Tier II once available if your build uses multiple charge types.
bullets: Tier I early, Tier II late.

sections.title: Bossing Usage
paragraphs: Against a boss, steady charge generation from a profusion-augmented generator keeps your damage buffs active through the fight.
If the boss phase rarely lets you generate charges, the support contributes less — pair it with a generator you can trigger reliably.

sections.title: Build Usage
paragraphs: Charge Profusion fits charge-stacking builds such as Explosive Witchhunter (Combat Frenzy) and any Power-charge generator setup.
It is strongest when your build both generates and consumes the same charge type consistently.

sections.title: Troubleshooting
paragraphs: If no extra charge appears, the supported skill is not a charge generator — socket it into Combat Frenzy or another generator. If the random charge seems missing, it is not shown separately in the UI; it is rolled silently.
If you cannot find 'Profusion', the gem was renamed to Charge Profusion; search that. If your charge cap is full, extra charges are wasted.
bullets: No extra: not a generator skill.
Random charge not in UI: silent roll.
Wrong random type: wasted if unusable.

sections.title: Known Issues
paragraphs: A common mistake is socketing Charge Profusion into a non-generator skill expecting free charges — it only adds to existing generation. Another is assuming the random charge always helps; if your build cannot use the rolled type, it is lost.

sections.title: Community Evidence
paragraphs: Charge Profusion is discussed as a strong enabler for charge-stacking builds in 0.5 threads, with the rename from 'Profusion' causing search confusion.
Players note the silent random charge roll is not shown in the UI, leading to 'where did my charge go' questions.
bullets: Random charge is a silent roll.
